statement: The Docker runtime consumes the complete npm-installed production dependency tree without a competing package-internal pruning policy, and the ordinary release-contract tests reject post-install mutations before tagging; the existing SQLite and PostgreSQL production parser witnesses and release proof remain green.

constraints.statement: Use npm production installation as the dependency closure owner; do not maintain a Docker-local list of dialects or native package internals to retain.
Limit implementation to Docker packaging, its existing release-contract witnesses, release notes and generated proof metadata; do not alter SQL semantics, release gates or publication credentials.
Demonstrate a failing ordinary test against the old Dockerfile before repairing it, and retain behavioral proof for both production SQL dialect imports.
Never move or delete existing release tags; any changed bytes ship through publish, exact-SHA CI and release preflight as the next 0.2 patch.
